clips.title: The story
paras: East of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot keeps Alliance vehicles and machinery in working order. Beldin Steelgrill and his crew handle repairs, tinker supplies, and salvage efforts.

Steelgrill's Depot rings with clanking metal, hissing steam vents, and the hum of experimental engines. Just off the snowy road east of Kharanos, dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather among heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and stockpiles of raw ores hauled from nearby quarries. Trogg disruptions and shortages of mechanical supplies trouble Dun Morogh. Beldin Steelgrill and his crew keep Alliance machinery in working order, making the depot an indispensable stop for travelers seeking spare parts or technical guidance in the bitter cold.
